parole.significato: common gull, also known as mew gull (Larus canus).
parole.testo: Apparently borrowed from Estonian kajakas (“seagull”), dialectal kajak, but, given Latvian kaija (“seagull”), and since ak is a formative element often found in Indo-European animal names, Latvian kajaks may have been the original word and Estonian kajakas the borrowing.

parole.significato: play (dramatic composition or a performance thereof)

parole.testo: Probably borrowed from Estonian madar, from Proto-Finnic *matara.
